summary: Quiet 12 hours. The dealer and auction finds that could be read are all still listed, unchanged except the Grays beavertail trailer, which is drawing bids. Facebook could not be checked this run, so the Facebook finds are left as they were last night.
headlines: Nothing new worth a call since last night.
Grays RBM 7.8t beavertail now $1,509 with 31 bids (was $209), reserve not met, closes Wed 22 Oct 8pm.
JD 6630 Tottenham clearing sale Fri 23 Oct, inspection Thu 22 Oct; still no guide.
Facebook not checked this run: Chrome did not respond.

finds.title: Farm-Aid FA106 heavy duty single-tine ripper (new)
finds.price_note: inc GST, freight extra, delivery Australia-wide
detail: suits 60 hp and up (no upper rating stated)
finds.why: Cheapest new heavy single tyne with 700 mm working depth, still $1,145 on 18 Oct; get a freight quote to Darlington Point.

finds.title: Hayes Extra Heavy Duty single-tine ripper with pipelayer (new)
detail: single 150 x 50 mm solid steel billet shank
rated 60-120 hp (90-120 hp for hard, dry soil)
about 650 mm ripping depth (spec table says 900 mm, lower pin to tip)
needs 3PL lift over 900 mm at the balls
stock level not shown on page
finds.why: Only listing with a published 90-120 hp hard-ground rating and a 150 x 50 mm billet shank; unchanged at $1,290 on 18 Oct.

finds.title: Linkage single-tyne ripper, North Yalgogrin
detail: no hp or shank size stated
finds.why: Closest unit to home and still $250; the bent tip needs a look, and the listing gives no hp or shank size.

finds.title: Massey Ferguson single-tyne deep ripper, 3PL (two available)
detail: two units: one lighter 1.4 m with top link, one heavy-duty large solid frame
heavy one has some rear-frame damage, still works
finds.why: The heavy-frame unit is the pick at $270, but it has frame damage and is 390 km away; price unchanged on 18 Oct.

finds.title: Massey Ferguson single-tine ripper, 3PL
finds.why: Undamaged MF single tine at $350 firm, but no hp or depth stated; unchanged after 16 weeks.

finds.title: Jarrett single-tyne ripper with pipe layer, 3PL
detail: Jarrett brand, part of an estate sale
single tyne on a tall gusseted A-frame (from photo)
no hp, shank size or depth stated
finds.why: A proper single-tyne build from a known Australian maker at under half the new price, still $600; no hp rating and about 380 km away.

finds.title: 24-plate trailing offset disc, used once (Eco-Offset decal)
detail: condition listed as new, used once
seller says it needs 75hp to pull
selling because the farm is being sold
frame decal reads Eco-Offset; the text still does not name the maker
finds.why: Near-new 24-plate 50 km away, about $7,400 under a new Serafin Eco 24 ($19,376). Ask the maker and measure the width before driving over.

finds.title: Shearer 300 24-plate trailing offset disc
detail: new 22in scallop discs on front gang
finds.why: Cheapest proper unit, with new front discs, but 2.4 m is narrow and the listing gives no hp rating.

finds.title: Blue Line 28-plate offset disc, new bearings and ram seals, width not stated
detail: disc gang bearings replaced as required
width and model not stated; no Blue Line maker spec found online to cite
finds.why: Closest used 28-plate, with the bearing work done. Measure the width and check plate wear in person.

finds.title: Heavy duty Australian made 24-plate offset discs
detail: front gang of 12 discs just replaced with new bearings, receipt over $5,000
seller says it needs at least 90hp
finds.why: Meets every must and the front gang was just redone, but it is at the edge of the 400 km range and the rear plates are at about 60%.

finds.title: New 1BZ-2.5 24-plate trailing offset disc, crated
detail: listing's own spec table gives 2,500 mm working width (2,810 mm overall); the text above it says 1,900 mm
new, comes unassembled in an iron crate
finds.why: Brand new for the price of a used set, but it is a light Chinese build rated to 100hp and needs assembling.

finds.title: Baldan CRSG28 28-plate trailing offset disc
detail: seller says it needs about 130hp; pulled with a Case 1370
plates worn: seller quoted $135+GST a plate to replace (about $3,800+GST for 28)
width not stated by seller; a WA dealer's new CRSG28 lists 3,200 mm and 125-140hp
Serafin (Yoogali) lists a new CRSG 28+1 at $24,400+GST
buyer must load and cart it
finds.why: A proper heavy Brazilian 28-plate at a third of new, but it sits at the top of the hp range and needs about $3,800 in plates to bite like new.

finds.title: Jarrett 28-plate offset discs, hardly used
finds.price_note: ONO; page shows US$9,000 but the seller's text says $9000 ono
detail: 28 plates, Jarrett; model not named and no Jarrett spec found online to cite
seller says excellent condition, hardly used
bearing and plate wear not stated
finds.why: A hardly-used 28-plate for $9,000 about 200 km away, but the listing is three lines long: get the width and hp before driving.

finds.title: Transportable cabin / granny flat, 8m x 3.2m
finds.price_note: open to offers; listing shows reduced from $20,000
detail: buyer to remove, seller can organise transport
finds.why: Still the cheapest unit that clears both musts, at $7,000 and 170km away, and open to offers. Condition is fair, so inspect before paying.

finds.title: Expanding container cabin, 2 bed, full bathroom, base unit (new)
detail: full bathroom, plumbed ready to connect
dealer: GV Containers and Haulage, free delivery within 30km of Cobram, delivery further out at extra cost
finds.why: New 2-bed with a full bathroom, in stock 180km away. GST could take it close to $22k and it still needs wiring, but it is the cheapest new 2-bed nearby.

finds.title: Off-grid shipping container home, 2 bed, 2 lounges, kitchen, bathroom
detail: solar off-grid system, 12 volt electrical, gas hot water
body says 2 x 40ft containers, title says 2 x 20ft; size unconfirmed
used, good condition; furniture included if wanted
buyer arranges and pays all transport and must take it apart if required
listed 20 weeks ago, still up 18 Oct
finds.why: A lived-in 2-bed with a kitchen, bathroom and off-grid power for $22,000, 260km away. It has sat for 20 weeks, so there is room to offer, but moving two containers will cost real money.

finds.title: New expanding container cabin, 2 bed, bathroom, kitchen
detail: L-shaped kitchen cabinets, stainless sink, mixer tap
electrical and plumbing ready for connection
finds.why: Premium model from the same Cobram dealer with the kitchen fitted; it clears every must and every prefer at 180km.

finds.title: Relocatable home, 2 bed, kitchen-dining, lounge, bathroom, laundry, 10m x 6m
detail: 10m x 6m, moves in two 10m x 3m sections
buyer to remove; transport cost not stated
finds.why: The biggest real home in range, with 2 bedrooms, a lounge and a laundry for $25,000. At 330km in two sections, transport is the main extra cost.

finds.title: New 20ft expandable granny flat, 2 bed, bathroom, kitchenette
detail: new, 20ft expandable, folds to 20ft container size for transport
insulated walls, double glazed windows, 2.4m ceiling
dimensions opened out, weight and electrical not stated
pickup only, transport cost not stated
same seller posts this ad under several north Melbourne suburbs, so the yard may be about 390km away
finds.why: At $18,000 it is the cheapest new 2-bed with a bathroom in range. Confirm where it is collected from and whether GST is extra before counting on it.

finds.title: New heavy-duty stick rake, 2100 mm, Euro hitch, side wings
detail: high-grade steel tynes at 155 mm spacing
hp rating and tyne section not stated
finds.why: Cheapest new Euro-hitch loader rake found at $1,890, 2.1m wide to sit inside the P5130 loader frame.

finds.title: New stick rake, tractor Euro hitch or skid steer hitch
finds.price_note: inc GST ($2,900 + GST); freight not stated
detail: tines laser cut from 16 mm Bisalloy 350 plate
Euro hitch, skid steer or blank back
finds.why: Heavy Bisalloy plate tines at $3,190, but width is not stated; ask before buying.

finds.title: Digga stick rake for Euro hitch tractors, 2130 mm (new, made to order)
finds.price_note: from, inc GST; shipping calculated at checkout
finds.why: Known maker and heaviest spec found at 290 kg, but made to order and posted, so add freight and lead time.

finds.title: Berrigan Economy Harrows stick rake 2400 HD, Euro hitch (new)
finds.price_note: inc GST ($4,691 + GST); delivers nationally, freight not stated
detail: 20 mm high-tensile tynes at 150 mm spacing
Euro hitch standard, other hitches made to order
weight and hp rating not stated
finds.why: Closest Euro rake at 160km and a local maker, but $3,270 more than the Seymour rake; check 2.4m clears the front tyres.

finds.title: BEH stick rake 2400 with wings, Euro hitch (new)
finds.price_note: inc GST ($4,691 + GST); delivers nationally, freight not stated
detail: 20 mm high-tensile tynes at 130 mm spacing
weight and hp rating not stated
finds.why: Same Berrigan maker and price as the HD, with wings and tighter 130 mm spacing for smaller debris.

finds.title: 2022 McCormick S-Max 90hp 4WD cab tractor with loader and 4-in-1 bucket, 251 hours
finds.price_note: private sale; GST not mentioned; seller will consider a swap for an Iveco tray truck
detail: 90hp turbo diesel, 4WD (the seller lists it as 'McCormick SMAX 90 HP 4WD 2022')
4-in-1 bucket; the photo shows a McCormick-branded loader, but the loader model is not stated
still listed 18 Oct at the same price after 10 weeks; service history and AdBlue not stated
a 2024 ex-demo S-Max 90 cab is advertised in NSW at $55,000 drive away with the loader extra (search result only; the listing could not be opened)
finds.why: Still the best value on the list: a 2022 cab tractor with a 4-in-1 loader at 251 hrs, 190 km away. It is $18,000 under the ceiling and has sat 10 weeks, so there is room to offer.

finds.title: 2008 John Deere 6630 with JD 741 loader (Tottenham clearing sale, lot 1)
finds.price_note: clearing sale Fri 23 Oct 12:00pm AEDT; no guide, reserve or bid shown (checked 18 Oct); 0% buyer premium; vendor GST registered
detail: John Deere 741 loader, Euro hitch, level lift, joystick, GP bucket
A/C cab, TLS front axle suspension, FWA, 2 remotes, 540/540E/1000 PTO
vendor bought it new, described as well maintained and in excellent condition
inspection Thu 22 Oct 10am-3pm at the Woolshed, 1955 Moira Vale Rd, Tottenham; pick-up 4 Nov
listing unchanged since 12 Oct (re-checked 18 Oct); sold as is, where is
finds.why: Clears every must with 1,552 hrs, a cab, a matching Deere loader, one owner and no buyer premium. The sale is in 5 days with no guide, so ring the agent before the 22 Oct inspection.

finds.title: 2007 Claas Celtis 436 cab tractor with front-end loader, 3,404 hours
detail: split in 2025 for a hydraulic leak: brakes overhauled, 3PL cylinder rebuilt
hp not stated in the listing
finds.why: Cheapest cab loader tractor on the list at $40,000 with 3,404 hrs and fresh 2025 repairs; confirm hp and why it was split.

finds.title: John Deere 5101 100hp 4WD cab loader tractor with 4-in-1 bucket
detail: 101hp JD 4045 4-cyl, mechanical fuel pump, no emissions gear
JD 563 quick-release FEL, 3rd function, joystick, Euro hitch, 4-in-1 bucket
dealer: Equipment Sales Pty Ltd, Lytton Rd, by appointment
finds.why: Simple non-emission 100hp Deere with a proper 563 loader at $71,500 inc GST, but 500 km away and 4,270 hrs is close to the ceiling.

finds.title: New 2026 McCormick S-MAX 90 cab tractor with front-end loader
finds.price_note: dealer new, excl. govt charges; GST treatment not stated
detail: new, 1 hour, 90hp 4-cyl turbo (the spec sheet lists the engine make as Sonalika)
12x12 shuttle, 2-speed PTO, 2 sets of rear hydraulic outlets
air-conditioned cab, front-end loader included; the bucket type is not stated
the dealer name and town are hidden behind a sign-in on farmmachinerysales
finds.why: Clears every must, new with a warranty and $8,500 under the ceiling. It is the same model as the 251-hr Yarroweyah tractor, which costs $9,500 less, and the dealer's town is not shown.

finds.title: 2010 McCormick T-Max 100 92hp 4WD with loader and 4-in-1 bucket, 1,375 hours
detail: 92hp Perkins engine, 1,375 hours, 4WD with rear diff lock
front-end loader with 4-in-1 bucket; loader make not stated
photo shows an enclosed cab, which the text does not mention
still listed 18 Oct at the same price, 10 weeks on; service history and AdBlue not stated; 410 km is just past the 400 km radius
finds.why: Clears every must at 92hp and 1,375 hrs with a cab and a 4-in-1 loader, and it is $7,400 under the ceiling. It is 410 km away and has sat for 10 weeks, so there is room to offer.

finds.title: 2014 John Deere 6150 with front-end loader (Barellan clearing sale, lot 1)
finds.price_note: clearing sale Thu 5 Nov 3:00pm AEDT; no guide, reserve or bid shown (checked 18 Oct); vendor GST registered; buyer premium not stated
detail: front-end loader with 3rd function, Euro hitch
front wheel assist with front suspension, 4 rear remotes, break-aways
auto track steering wheel, ISOBUS rear socket, new front tyres
hp still not stated on the page (unchanged since 14 Oct, re-checked 18 Oct); ask the agent whether it is inside the 140hp ceiling
photos show a cab, which the text does not mention
agent Rod Evans, Elders Griffith; pick-up by 22 Nov
finds.why: The closest loader tractor on the list: a Deere with 3,900 hrs and a 3rd-function loader, 110 km away. There is no guide and the hp is unconfirmed, so call Elders Griffith before 5 Nov.

finds.title: 2021 Deutz-Fahr 4080.4E cab 4WD with factory 4-in-1 FEL
detail: factory-fitted 4-in-1 FEL, Euro hitch, hay forks included
two owners, selling due to move
mulcher mower available for $50,000 the pair
finds.why: Cheap, new and low-houred, but the seller never states hp and the 4080 is likely under 90hp.
